DOC_LEGALIZE.title: {{label}} still needs consular legalization
DOC_LEGALIZE.why: {{university}} only accepts it once it is legalized.

DOC_IN_REVIEW.title: {{label}} is being checked
DOC_IN_REVIEW.why: Usually within 2 working days. Nothing to do.

DOC_REVIEW_LATE.title: {{label}} is being checked
DOC_REVIEW_LATE.why: It's taking longer than usual. We've told your counselor.

ESSAY_WRITE.title: Write your {{labelLower}}
ESSAY_WRITE.why: Your counselor reads it before it goes to the university.

ESSAY_REVIEW.title: {{label}} needs counselor review
ESSAY_REVIEW.why: Nothing to do. Your counselor is reading it.

ELIG_EDUCATION.title: The program needs a qualification you don't have yet
ELIG_EDUCATION.why: Talk to your counselor about programs you already qualify for.

ELIG_NATIONALITY.title: This program is not open to your nationality
ELIG_NATIONALITY.why: The university's published rules exclude applicants of your nationality.

ELIG_GPA.title: Your GPA is below the published minimum
ELIG_GPA.why: You have {{have}}%; the program asks for {{min}}% (converted to a 0–100 scale).

ELIG_LANGUAGE.title: Your language score is below the minimum
ELIG_LANGUAGE.why: A retake before the deadline, or an accepted alternative test, would meet it.

PROFILE_EDUCATION.title: Add your education history
PROFILE_EDUCATION.why: Without it we can't confirm you meet the entry requirement.

PROFILE_GPA.title: Add your GPA
PROFILE_GPA.why: The program publishes a minimum GPA; adding yours lets us check it.

EDUCATION_EXPECTED.title: Eligible once you graduate
EDUCATION_EXPECTED.why: Send your graduation certificate as soon as you receive it.

DEGREE_DIFFERENT.title: This is a different degree level from your goal

LANGUAGE_RECOMMENDED.title: TOPIK {{have}} meets the minimum; this program recommends {{recommended}}+
LANGUAGE_RECOMMENDED.why: Classes in Korean are demanding, and a higher level helps you keep up. It is not required to apply.

LANGUAGE_PLANNED.title: You have a language test planned
LANGUAGE_PLANNED.why: Send the result as soon as you have it.

FIELD_DIFFERENT.title: This program's field isn't one you listed
FIELD_DIFFERENT.why: That's fine if you chose it on purpose. Your study plan should explain why.

DEADLINE_PASSED.title: The application deadline has passed
DEADLINE_PASSED.why: The Hangyul team can check for a later round or intake.

DEADLINE_TIGHT.title: {{count}} items left and {{days}} days to the deadline
DEADLINE_TIGHT.why: Steps like legalization take weeks. Start the slowest one today.

BUDGET_OVER.title: The first-year cost starts above your budget
BUDGET_OVER.why: From {{low}} a year; your budget is {{budget}}. A scholarship or a different housing choice could close the gap.

BUDGET_TIGHT.title: The first-year cost may go above your budget
BUDGET_TIGHT.why: {{low}}–{{high}} a year; your budget is {{budget}}. It depends on housing and living costs.

BUDGET_UNKNOWN.title: Add your yearly budget
BUDGET_UNKNOWN.why: Then we can compare it with this program's first-year cost.

SCHOLARSHIP_APPLY.title: Apply for {{name}} by {{deadline}}
SCHOLARSHIP_APPLY.why: It needs a separate application. You appear to meet its published criteria.

SCHOLARSHIP_NONE.title: No scholarship here matches your profile yet
SCHOLARSHIP_NONE.why: You said you need one. Ask your counselor about other options.

INTERVIEW_REQUIRED.title: This program interviews applicants
INTERVIEW_REQUIRED.why: Your counselor can run a practice interview with you before it.

INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED.title: Prepare for your interview with {{university}}
INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED.why: A short practice with your counselor helps.

PORTFOLIO_REQUIRED.title: This program asks for a portfolio
PORTFOLIO_REQUIRED.why: Your counselor confirms the format the university expects.

PASSPORT_EXPIRES.title: Your passport expires on {{date}}
PASSPORT_EXPIRES.why: That's soon after you'd start. Renewing it before your visa application avoids a second round of paperwork.

FINAL_CHECK.title: Everything is in. The final check is next
FINAL_CHECK.why: Your counselor checks the whole application once, then it's ready to submit.

SUBMISSION_CONFIRM.title: Add your {{university}} confirmation
SUBMISSION_CONFIRM.why: You told us you submitted. Add the confirmation number or receipt to finish.

DOC_LEGALIZE_APOSTILLE.title: {{label}} still needs an apostille
DOC_LEGALIZE_APOSTILLE.why: {{university}} only accepts it once it is legalized.

SUBMISSION_AUTHORIZE.title: Authorize {{agency}} to submit your {{university}} application
SUBMISSION_AUTHORIZE.why: Your Hangyul application is ready. Nothing is submitted until you authorize it.

REQUIREMENT_CHANGED.title: {{university}} changed its admission rules after this application was started
REQUIREMENT_CHANGED.why: Your application stays as it is. Your counselor checks with the university whether the new rule applies to you.

ESSAY_WRONG_NAME.title: {{label}} names the wrong university
ESSAY_WRONG_NAME.why: An essay addressed to another university is the most common avoidable rejection.

ESSAY_OVER_LIMIT.title: {{label}} is over the length the university allows
ESSAY_OVER_LIMIT.why: Over-length essays are often cut off or returned unread.

ESSAY_PROMPT_GAP.title: {{label}} does not answer part of the prompt
ESSAY_PROMPT_GAP.why: The university scores each part of its question separately.

ESSAY_CONTRADICTS_PROFILE.title: {{label}} says something your documents do not
ESSAY_CONTRADICTS_PROFILE.why: A reviewer who finds one contradiction re-checks everything else.
